title: The Bugle Call: Song of War
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world dominated by nine ancient Spires, the Papal States and the Erin Empire wage war for control of their power. Luca, a 14-year-old bugler raised by mercenaries who dreams of becoming a musician, is one of the Branched, people with supernatural powers, and is recruited by the Pontiff to lead a team of them, including a mission to kill the Garland, a 13-year-old Branched who can destroy nations. The Pontiff, head of the Spirism faith, is portrayed as manipulative and exploitative.
life_message: Holding on to one's own dream and conscience matters even when powerful institutions use children as weapons of war.
